findings.title: Prevea Washington Street Health Center — permanent closure after November 13 final patient-care day
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The Prevea Washington Street Health Center will be closing permanently. The last day for patient care will be November 13, 2026.
findings.access_consequences: Provider confirms permanent closure of the 102 N. Washington St. health center after the November 13, 2026 last patient-care day. On-site family medicine, primary care, urgent care, lab/pathology, and radiology access at this location ends. No system-wide service cessation is established; patient reassignment and alternate clinic availability are unverified.
findings.affected_population: Existing and prospective patients using primary care, family medicine, urgent care, laboratory/pathology and radiology services at the Washington Street location; patient count unknown.
